title: Free Knight, Free Check
setup: Black's knight on g5 stands undefended on the same file as the king.
hint: The queen's diagonal reaches the knight, and the file it would land on reaches the king.
explanation:
## The Idea

The knight on g5 has no defender, and it stands on the same file as the king on g8.

{{Qxg5+}} takes it and gives check in the same move, so Black never gets a move to spend on anything else. The queen came down the diagonal; the file it lands on does the checking, and the king is too far away to take back.

This is not a fork — there was only ever one target — but it works for the same reason: the reply is already spoken for.
